bodyBase: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE individual production 2D game sprite, never a sheet, no text. Reference images are identity/style/scale references for the EXACT same alien boss. Preserve elongated backward swept smooth domed head, plum-magenta purple biomechanical carapace, ribbed glowing violet chest with zigzag sternum, white-violet almond eyes, muscular digitigrade legs and long curved claws, no tail. Match reference crisp highly detailed pixel-art shaded rendering, contours and highlights, camera facing lower-left in three-quarter front view. Maintain same anatomical head and torso size as reference on an EXACT 1254x1254 RGBA canvas, grounded feet baseline near y=1180; keep all anatomy within canvas with transparent margin. TRUE transparent alpha background, no black background, no checkerboard painted in, no floor, no drop shadow, no environment, no labels, no watermark. Pose changes must not redesign character.
firstPose: First combo anticipation, near-side arm drawn back upper-right, far arm guards chest.
bodyPoses: Combo_02_SlashA

First strike active contact: near-side arm has swept across chest and extends toward lower-left, long claws spread and reaching left, torso twists into swipe; far arm bent back. Keep same head orientation and feet. No trails.
Combo_03_RecoverA
Recovery after first horizontal slash: near-side forearm low across abdomen, elbow flexed withdrawing claws, shoulders relax slightly but knees remain braced. No trails.
Combo_04_PrepareB

Second strike anticipation, opposite arm: far-side arm raised outward toward screen-left with elbow bent ready for reverse claw swipe; near arm retracted by right hip, torso coiled opposite first strike. Feet planted, face lower left. No trails.
Combo_05_SlashB

Second strike active reverse swipe with opposite far-side arm crossing forward in front of ribs toward lower-left, claw hand prominent and extended, near-side arm held back by right hip, torso counter-rotated. Readable different silhouette from first strike. No trails.
Combo_06_RecoverB
Recovery after second swipe, both elbows bend inward bringing hands beside ribs, body begins straightening for overhead finisher, shoulders braced, face still lower left. No trails.
Combo_07_PrepareSlam

Overhead finisher windup: BOTH arms lifted high beside the head, elbows bent, claw hands raised above crown ready to slam toward lower-left. Deep braced knees. Head and torso retain reference size; do not crop hands, lower whole stance enough to keep fingers within frame. No effects.
Combo_08_Slam

Overhead finisher active contact: both arms driven forcefully diagonally down-forward to lower-left, both claw hands hit in front of feet, torso lunges bent forward and knees compress. Head faces lower-left. Clearly different from neutral leap landing: hands reach forward together. No floor, debris or effects.
Combo_09_RecoverSlam
Finisher recovery: exhausted forward stoop, knees bent, both claw hands hanging low just above ground and starting to retract, head lowered. Same body size and grounded baseline. No effects.
Trace_01_Observe

Trail tracking observation: standing braced slightly higher than idle, head lowered and focused to lower-left, both claws open held beside torso as if sensing, eyes glow much brighter white-violet with small localized purple halo. Keep rest of body unchanged; no beams, no ground, no trails.
Trace_02_Invoke

Trail tracking invocation: low braced stance, near-side claw hand raised beside face as if reading echoes, opposite arm reaches diagonally toward ground in front, eyes intense violet-white glow. No magic circles or extra objects. Same identity and scale.
Trace_03_Release

Trail tracking release command: torso leaning forward, both clawed hands extend down-forward with fingers spread, knees braced, brilliant white-violet eyes and brighter rib light. Hands suspended, not touching floor. No ground or external effects.
Leap_05_Recover

Recovery frame between reference landing and idle: torso halfway raised out of landing crouch, both palms just lifted from ground, knees still deeply bent; exact same head/torso/feet scale and left-facing view as reference. No effect or floor.
